planets.name: TOI-715 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-715 with a 19.3-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-715 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-715. Its orbit and size follow Dransfield et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DRANSFIELD_ET_AL_2024): disc_year 2023, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 19.288004, pl_radj 0.13828198, pl_bmassj 0.00951

quotes.title: TOI-715 b
quotes.card: TOI-715 b is a super-Earth exoplanet in the habitable zone of its parent M-type star, TOI-715.
quotes.introduction: The planet is 1.55 times larger than Earth, and is located at 0.083 astronomical units (12,400,000 km) from its star.
